        COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders,
        MIN(TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) AS earliest_date,

    FROM e_commerce.orders

    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    number_of_orders,
    average_payment,
    CASE

    END AS lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_data
ORDER BY average_payment DESC
LIMIT 3;
